prompt: Single continuous shot. Opens mid-action: curry powder hitting hot oil and blooming into an instant golden cloud, spices toasting fragrant. Onion collapses in, then coconut milk poured in a slow spiral that marbles cream through gold. Money shot: bright green peas cascading straight from the freezer bag into the simmering sauce in slow motion — vivid green against gold — folded through as the sauce coats them glossy, steam rolling backlit. Final beat: the curry spooned over a steaming mound of basmati, coconut flakes falling, a spoon breaking in. Warm light, deep shadows, film grain. Dominant sound: the spice bloom sizzle, then the pea cascade. No speech, no voice, no narration, no dialogue, no music.
